title: Animate the Lighthouse Just Made
tests: Tests resolving a follow-up to the previously generated picture and animating it rather than creating an unrelated scene.

faults.what: The scene looks photographic rather than watercolor; visible watercolor washes, brushwork, and paper texture are missing throughout the supplied frames.
The lighthouse light and its reflection change brightness, but a beam slowly sweeping across the water is not clearly visible.
The reported clip duration is 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: The clip shows a stable striped lighthouse at dusk with moving surf, but lacks the requested watercolor appearance and a clearly sweeping lighthouse beam.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is a playable 6-second landscape video in 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied video frames are approximately 16:9 landscape, but the stated duration is 6.6 seconds; playback cannot be verified from stills.

must_haves.item: The lighthouse's red-and-white stripes, rocky coastline and composition visibly correspond to the first-turn picture.
must_haves.why: The stripes and rocky coastline are visible and remain consistent across frames, but the first-turn picture was not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The watercolor appearance and dusk lighting remain visible throughout.
must_haves.why: Dusk lighting remains consistent, but the rendering appears photographic rather than watercolor.

must_haves.item: Waves visibly move against the rocks and a lighthouse beam sweeps across the water.
must_haves.why: Changing surf and splashes show wave movement against the rocks. The lamp and water reflection vary, but the frames do not show a clear directional beam sweep.

must_haves.item: There is no added writing or audible sound.
must_haves.why: No writing is visible in the supplied frames, but audio cannot be assessed from still images.
